# Arctura Network

Arctura Network is the network and governance discovery surface for the Arctura ecosystem.

Canonical: https://arctura.network/
Service descriptor: https://arctura.network/.well-known/aureus.json
Agent card: https://arctura.network/.well-known/agent.json
Ecosystem registry: https://base.arctura.network/network.json

Operational note: A2A, MCP, AP2, and autonomous settlement references describe architecture unless an endpoint is explicitly marked implemented in the agent card.
